articles.title: FORT Robotics to take safety stack public via SPAC merger

articles.title: HMS-SCP: Task-Oriented Multi-Scale Semantic Communication for V2X Cooperative Perception
articles.summary: The paper introduces HMS-SCP, a bandwidth-efficient semantic communication framework for V2X cooperative perception in autonomous driving. It uses multi-scale task-relevant feature selection and joint source-channel coding to reduce network load while maintaining robust detection performance under noisy channel conditions and severe compression.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early-stage technical development rather than a commercial deployment, but it highlights a key bottleneck for autonomous vehicles and smart transportation systems: moving sensor data efficiently across constrained networks. If approaches like this mature, they could support broader adoption of connected vehicle infrastructure, edge AI, and safety-critical perception systems.

articles.title: Drones With Claws Perch on Arctic Icebergs
articles.summary: Researchers at Université de Sherbrooke developed the Ice Dart, a lightweight drone with retractable microspine landing gear that can perch on steep icy surfaces such as icebergs and glaciers. Field tests in Iceland showed 100% successful perching at speeds up to 3 meters per second, slopes up to 58 degrees, and winds up to 30 km/h. The team plans to deploy the drone on a Canadian Arctic mission to collect data and help validate ship-based iceberg-detection systems.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early-stage field robotics development rather than a direct public-company investment story, but it illustrates how specialized drones can expand data collection in hard-to-reach environments.
